# Bageo v1.4.0

- **A calmer console.** Softer, low-contrast colors and plain text controls instead of decorative icons.
- **SIM line numbers.** The System page shows each phone's numbers (you can type one in when a card does not report it), incoming calls show which line was called, and AI errands let you pick the number to call from.
- **Recordings and cleanup.** Download any call's recording, delete one call or all finished calls, and remove offline phones.
- **Chinese script conversion now uses OpenCC**, and the license and legal files are tidied up.
- **Phone module update needed** for SIM numbers to show up.

## 繁體中文

- **更耐看的控制台。** 柔和的低對比配色，用文字按鈕取代裝飾圖示。
- **顯示門號。** 「系統」頁會列出每支手機的門號（讀不到時可自己輸入）；來電會顯示打給哪個門號；「AI 代打」可以選要用哪個門號撥出。
- **錄音與清理。** 可下載任一通錄音、刪除單筆或全部已結束的通話紀錄、移除離線的舊手機。
- **簡繁轉換改用 OpenCC**，並整理授權與免責文件。
- **要看到門號，手機模組也要更新。**

Full changes / 完整變更：[CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/h4lo-void/bageo-call/blob/v1.4.0/CHANGELOG.md)
